'''Vell Narroc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He worked as a recruiter for the Republic's [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guard Project]] at the project's [[Power Guard recruitment center|recruitment center]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and was captured by Imperials when Lord [[Sadic]] seized control of the project. He and his fellow recruiters were freed when an [[Hero of Tython|unknown]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] arrived and defeated the Imperial shocktroopers. Upon learning that the Jedi was searching for Agent [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]], Narroc directed the Knight to the [[Power Guard Cybernetics Lab|project's lab]] in the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]].

==Behind the scenes==
Vell Narroc was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears in the Jedi Knight storyline on Nar Shaddaa, as part of the mission "The Search for Agent Galen".<ref name="TOR" />
